title: Fixed-coordinate frequency lift
statement: Let $J$ be a finite subset of the coordinates $Fin(n)$. The fixed-coordinate frequency lift sends a function $gamma$ on the reindexed coordinates outside $J$ to the unique coefficient vector on all $n$ coordinates whose dot product with any vector over $mathbb{F}_2$ equals the dot product of $gamma$ with that vector's restriction to the coordinates outside $J$.
caveat: The definition is expressed via the dual-space equivalence; the intended coefficient-vector interpretation is inferred from that construction.
